name: Junior District Attorney and Investigator Mentorship Program
org: Gwinnett Judicial Circuit District Attorney's Office
what_you_do: Get a hands-on look at courts, police, jails and prosecutors. You work with assistant district attorneys and investigators. You also work with office staff. You can earn community service hours.
who_can_apply: You must be 15 to 18 years old and go to a Gwinnett County public school. Case by case, the program may approve school outside Gwinnett County. You must be in good standing in your school and community.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated. The page says participants can earn community service hours.
deadline_text: Applications for the sixth group open in April 2027 and the summer experience begins in June 2027. No deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. The parent and the student both sign it online. Go to orientation. Turn in a recommendation from a teacher, a school leader or a community leader.
notes: The page does not say whether it pays, how long it lasts or what the exact opening date is. No essay is mentioned. County phone: 770.822.8000.
